title: Rice (Rice Cooker)
instructions: Rinse the rice in a fine-mesh strainer under cold water until the water runs mostly clear. Drain well.
Put the rice in the rice cooker pot. Add the water for your version (white: 1 cup; brown: 1 1/4 cups) and the salt if using.
Close the lid and start the cooker (use the brown-rice setting for brown rice if your cooker has one). White rice takes about 20 minutes; brown rice about 45 minutes.
When the cooker finishes, let the rice rest, lid closed, for 10 minutes.
Fluff with a fork or rice paddle and serve.
notes: Everyday staple Yidi asked to add for planning purposes. Choose a version before cooking: White (default) or Brown. Both times are in the steps — brown is the long version.
